REMINDER
This Friday, July 31 st , is the last day to pay your 2025 taxes to avoid having your name published in the newspaper and an additional publication fee of $17.00 added to each parcel. Can’t remember if you paid your 2 nd half taxes? Call the Treasurer’s Office at 223-3800 Ext. 803.
Treasurer
The Bourbon County Treasurer’s Office is open Monday-Friday 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. and is responsible for:
Processing all motor vehicle registrations.
Accepting and processing payment of real estate and personal property taxes.
Distributing monies to all the taxing entities at the County and State level.
Investing of Idle Funds.
The County Treasurer is an agent for the State of Kansas for motor vehicle titles and tags.
Real Estate and Personal Property Taxes
The first half of the Real Estate and Personal Property taxes are due by December 20 of each year. If you opt to pay taxes in two halves, the second half is due by May 10 of each year. Your statement will have two detachable stubs at the bottom, one for the first half payment and one for the second half payment. No second-half statements are sent. CLICK HERE to view Property Tax information. If you have delinquent real estate taxes or personal property, please contact us at (620) 223-3800 Ext. 803 for the total amount due. The due dates for Real Estate and Personal Property tax payments are set by state statute.
Motor Vehicle Services
The Bourbon County Treasurer’s Office stops accepting title work at 4:15 p.m. each day.
Do you need an estimate on property taxes for a new vehicle purchase?
Click this link https://mvs.dmv.kdor.ks.gov/VehiclePropertyTaxLookup/ to go to the State of Kansas Property Tax Estimator.
Reprint Registration Renewal Form(s)
Reprint Registration Renewal Form(s) (sent from the State of Kansas)
Motor Vehicle Forms
To download motor vehicle forms please visit the Kansas Department of Revenue website . These forms are Adobe Acrobat format and require Acrobat Reader 3.0 or above to open.
